transcript: Scan the insertion coordinate for the BeH2 conical intersection and show active space orbitals.
narrative: Scanning the **Purvis-Bartlett insertion coordinate (x = 2.50 Bohr)** for the **BeH₂ Avoided Crossing / Conical Intersection**. As the two hydrogen atoms insert into the central beryllium atom along the C₂ᵥ coordinate, the system traverses the avoided crossing seam at **x ≈ 2.54 Bohr**. The three active-space natural orbitals displayed across your top panel track the **1a₁** core/valence orbital and the two crossing orbitals **1b₂** and **3a₁**. Notice how the kinetic collision operator regularizes the mean-field energy cusp, enabling a smooth, continuous exchange of orbital occupations relaxing to `[2.0, 1.99, 1.5071]` with an informational entropy of **3.6565 bits** and total energy of **-413.7841 eV**.
